title: residuated-lattice
description: A commutative residuated lattice 𝐋 = ⟨L, ∨, ∧, ·, →, 1⟩ whose order is a lattice and whose fusion · forms a commutative monoid with unit 1, with a residual → adjoint to ·; it is the carrier positing generates as the algebra of truth-degrees for the potential predication cell.

carrier.description: the underlying set L of truth-degrees

lattice.description: ⟨L, ∨, ∧⟩ is a lattice (join ∨ and meet ∧ giving the order x ≤ y iff x ∧ y = x)

monoid.description: ⟨L, ·, 1⟩ is a commutative monoid: · is associative, commutative, and has unit 1

fusion.description: the fusion product ·, the monoid multiplication

residual.description: the residual →, right adjoint to fusion

residuation.description: the adjunction x · y ≤ z ⟺ x ≤ y → z for all x, y, z ∈ L

integral.description: 1 is the top element of the lattice
